dataset_name: Block Assignment Files, Virginia, 2020 Census blocks
known_caveats: The _CD member carries the 116th Congress -- 2010-era district lines expressed in 2020 blocks -- not the 2022 round. Census publishes no BAF for the 2022 round, so RD-003 derives that assignment from TIGER cd118 polygons. The _VTD member's DISTRICT field is not one format: some counties embed their own FIPS (Alleghany writes precinct 101 as 005101, Accomack as 000101).
